name: I-MED Radiology Network Medical Imaging Bursary
summary: A bursary for QUT Medical Imaging students willing to do a third-year placement at a regional I-MED site.
who: Domestic or international students in CS48 Bachelor of Medical Imaging (Honours), in Year 2 when applying.
Willing to do a Year 3 placement at an eligible I-MED regional site.
how: Apply with the application form, a CV and a response to the selection criteria.
catches: The terms found cover the Semester 2, 2025 round. Check the current round with health.engage@qut.edu.au.

evidence.quote: Must hold a minimum course (cumulative) grade point average (GPA) of 5.0 at the time of application
